unit_label: BRBL C U01: Integrated Ombudsman Scheme 2021 (30 June 2026 snapshot) — Apply the amended regulated-entity scope without confusing credit-information companies and excluded investment-company categories

facts.locator: printed pp.224–226; PDF page = printed page + 19
facts.statement: Courseware lists original bank/NBFC/system-participant coverage and August 2022 credit-information inclusion; its bank list omits the later 2025 expansion.

Amended definitions include Credit Information Company and related deficiency language; NBFC definition has specified exclusions. Its system-participant definition expressly excludes RBI and a system provider, unlike the broad PSS Act definition.

Specified State/Central Co-operative Banks added effective 1 November 2025. Paragraph4 lists bank categories, non-scheduled primary UCB deposit threshold, the alternative NBFC coverage branches, system participants and Credit Information Companies, subject to exclusions.

payload.title: Coverage is a category-and-exclusion enquiry
payload.core_explanation_md:
Do not apply the older courseware bank list as the complete 30 June 2026 position. The October 2025 notification added the specified State and Central Co-operative Banks from 1 November 2025. It also states the relevant bank, NBFC, system-participant and Credit Information Company categories, subject to the scheme exclusions.

Read the exact branch of the coverage rule. The non-scheduled primary urban co-operative bank threshold and the NBFC conditions are not a single size test imposed on every institution. For an actual institution, category, measured date, relevant threshold and exclusions all need evidence. Being broadly RBI-regulated is not by itself the entire inclusion test.

self_check.prompt_text: Why is the original textbook list insufficient for the pinned June 2026 coverage enquiry?
self_check.expected_takeaway: A later pre-cutoff notification expanded coverage and must be read with the scheme exclusions.

payload.title: The NBFC branches are alternatives, not a universal asset threshold
payload.core_explanation_md:
The coverage notification distinguishes NBFCs authorised to accept deposits from the stated customer-interface-and-asset-size branch, while excluding Housing Finance Companies and retaining the scheme qualifications. A reviewer should identify which branch the facts rely on rather than attach the customer-interface asset threshold to every NBFC without reading the text.

The scheme NBFC definition also contains specified exclusions. Keep **Core Investment Company** distinct from **Credit Information Company**: the similar initials do not make these the same legal category. The amended scheme expressly includes the latter category while the NBFC definition treats the former differently. Use full names in ambiguous files.

self_check.prompt_text: Why should the full company category be written rather than relying on the initials CIC?
self_check.expected_takeaway: Core Investment Company and Credit Information Company are distinct categories with different treatment in these provisions.

payload.title: A familiar term can have a scheme-specific definition
payload.core_explanation_md:
The PSS Act participant definition is broad, but the inspected 2021 Ombudsman scheme defines its system participant by excluding RBI and the system provider. Copying the PSS definition unchanged into this scheme would lose that qualification. Always read a defined term in the instrument actually being applied.

The amended deficiency definition also does not require financial loss in every case. A service shortcoming can therefore raise a complaint question even where the reviewer cannot identify a monetary loss. That does not guarantee maintainability or an award: exclusions, complaint conditions and available relief still need separate examination.

self_check.prompt_text: Does the absence of a financial loss automatically establish that there is no possible deficiency in service?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. The definition allows a shortcoming with or without financial loss, subject to the rest of the scheme.

payload.stem_md: A reviewer excludes a State Co-operative Bank solely because it is absent from the original 2021 coverage list in the book. The question is expressly pinned to 30 June 2026. Which evidence must be considered?

options.text_md: The October 2025 notification adding the specified State/Central Co-operative Banks from 1 November 2025
options.explanation_md: This predates the cutoff and changes the coverage enquiry, subject to exclusions.

options.text_md: Only the cover year of the textbook
options.explanation_md: The book year does not replace later operative primary notifications.

options.text_md: An assumption that every cooperative body is necessarily covered
options.explanation_md: The notification defines specified categories and retains exclusions; a broad label is insufficient.

options.text_md: The July 2026 commencement alone, ignoring all earlier amendments
options.explanation_md: A later commencement does not erase a distinct November 2025 coverage change.

payload.correct_explanation_md: This predates the cutoff and changes the coverage enquiry, subject to exclusions.

payload.stem_md: A file uses the initials CIC and treats an excluded Core Investment Company as identical to a Credit Information Company included in the amended framework. What should correct the classification?

options.text_md: Use only whichever expansion gives the larger asset figure
options.explanation_md: Asset size does not decide which legal company category the initials denote.

options.text_md: Assume all company definitions are interchangeable under one acronym
options.explanation_md: The categories have different definitions and statutory treatment.

options.text_md: Identify the full company type and apply its own inclusion/exclusion provisions
options.explanation_md: Writing the full type prevents the acronym from collapsing distinct categories.

options.text_md: Use one entity RBI registration as proof that every entity sharing its initials is included
options.explanation_md: An individual registration and an acronym do not establish the distinct category and exclusion rules.

payload.correct_explanation_md: Writing the full type prevents the acronym from collapsing distinct categories.

payload.stem_md: A question imports the PSS Act participant definition into the 2021 Ombudsman scheme without reading the latter definition. Which scheme qualification is at risk?

options.text_md: Import the PSS participant wording unchanged because both instruments concern payments
options.explanation_md: A shared subject does not override the Ombudsman scheme own express definition.

options.text_md: That financial loss is compulsory for every service deficiency
options.explanation_md: The deficiency definition allows a non-financial-loss case.

options.text_md: That a threshold automatically removes all scheme exclusions
options.explanation_md: A threshold does not displace exclusions.

options.text_md: The scheme definition excludes RBI and the system provider from its system-participant term
options.explanation_md: The definition is instrument-specific and cannot be replaced by the broader PSS wording.

payload.correct_explanation_md: The definition is instrument-specific and cannot be replaced by the broader PSS wording.
